title: A Homecoming for the Recipe
author: Gideon Winterbourne
blurb: Beatrix Pemberton, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
